svg.title: U-Net 的相鄰方法比較圖
svg.desc: 三種相關方法並排，比較它們的它如何表示輸入與會交出什麼候選；底部標示共同的人工 review 邊界。

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 比輸入表示與候選輸出

text.font-family: Microsoft JhengHei, PingFang TC, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 分類、分割與姿態方法可能讀同一張影像，卻把它轉成不同層級的 class、mask 或座標候選。

g.data-semantic-relation: show the authored operation before action
g.data-must-show: U-Net：依據：固定 pixel label/ignore/boundary contract 下的 encoder context 與 same-scale skip feature | candidate output: 可用輸出：per-pixel semantic logits/mask；touching instances 與量測另接模型外規則 | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: U-Net output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: U-Net：依據：固定 pixel label/ignore/boundary contract 下的 encoder context 與 same-scale skip feature

g.data-semantic-relation: show the authored operation before action
g.data-must-show: SegFormer：依據：hierarchical multi-scale token/feature maps 與 MLP decoder 的已知語意 labels | candidate output: 可用輸出：semantic mask；IoU/probability 不等於 instance identity 或 CD precision | Same input, ROI, preprocess, truth, and evidence gate; do not switch the comparison contract.
g.data-not-claim: SegFormer output is a candidate, not verified field truth; still use the evidence gate.
g.title: SegFormer：依據：hierarchical multi-scale token/feature maps 與 MLP decoder 的已知語意 labels
